stemMd: A password uses three different letters from P,Q,R,S. P must be included. How many ordered passwords are possible?
explanationMd: Choose P’s position in three ways. Fill the other two positions with two distinct letters from the remaining three in 3×2 ways. Total is 3×6=18. Equivalently subtract the six passwords without P from all twenty-four.

distractorRationale.b: This undercounts orderings of the other two letters.
distractorRationale.c: This misses some possible positions for P.
distractorRationale.e: This includes passwords that omit P.
distractorRationale.a: This fixes one pair of other letters instead of allowing all choices.
